paragraph.en: Although we will never know everything there is to know about Jehovah, it is possible, to a certain extent, to get to know what he is like. King David told his son Solomon: “Know the God of your father and serve him with a complete heart . . . If you search for him, he will let himself be found by you.” ( 1 Chron. 28:9 ) As the apostle John reminded his fellow Christians centuries later, we have “insight so that we may gain the knowledge of the one who is true.” ( 1 John 5:20 ) And Jesus himself said that knowledge of Jehovah is available to “anyone to whom the Son is willing to reveal him.”​— Matt. 11:27 .
paragraph.tl: Hindi natin malalaman ang lahat ng tungkol kay Jehova, pero posible pa rin natin siyang makilala. Sinabi ni Haring David sa anak niyang si Solomon: “Kilalanin mo ang Diyos ng iyong ama at maglingkod ka sa kaniya nang buong puso . . . Kung hahanapin mo siya, hahayaan niyang makita mo siya.” ( 1 Cro. 28:9 ) Gaya naman ng sinabi ni apostol Juan sa mga kapuwa niya Kristiyano pagkalipas ng maraming taon, binigyan tayo ni Jesus ng “unawa para magkaroon tayo ng kaalaman sa tunay na Diyos.” ( 1 Juan 5:20 ) At sinabi mismo ni Jesus na puwedeng magkaroon ng kaalaman tungkol kay Jehova “ang sinumang gustong turuan ng Anak tungkol sa Ama.”​— Mat. 11:27 .

paragraph.en: All who dedicated themselves to Jehovah have already learned many things about him. Yet, we never stop “coming to know” Jehovah. ( John 17:3 ; see study note .) We can always learn more about what makes him happy and how to deepen our trust in him. Let us discuss three questions that all of us should consider no matter how long we have served Jehovah: What does it mean to come to know Jehovah? Why should we continue to get to know him better? And how do we get to know him better?
paragraph.tl: Bilang mga lingkod ni Jehova, marami na tayong natutuhan tungkol sa kaniya. Pero lagi pa rin tayong may matututuhang bago tungkol kay Jehova. ( Juan 17:3 ; tingnan ang study note .) Halimbawa, puwede pa tayong matuto nang higit tungkol sa kung ano ang nagpapasaya sa kaniya at kung paano pa natin mapapatibay ang pagtitiwala natin sa kaniya. Kaya gaano man tayo katagal nang naglilingkod kay Jehova, dapat nating pag-isipan ang tatlong tanong na ito: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng pagkilala kay Jehova? Bakit dapat natin siyang patuloy na kilalanin? At paano natin siya mas makikilala? Iyan ang tatalakayin natin sa artikulong ito.

question.en: What is involved in coming to know Jehovah?
question.tl: Ano ang kasama sa pagkilala kay Jehova?

Jehovah promised: “I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Jehovah.” ( Jer. 24:7 ) Surely those who returned from Babylon already knew basic facts about Jehovah. (Jer. 24:7 )

paragraph.en: We learn what is involved in coming to know Jehovah by considering what he said about the Jews who would return from exile. Jehovah promised: “I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Jehovah.” ( Jer. 24:7 ) Surely those who returned from Babylon already knew basic facts about Jehovah. But their efforts to come to know Jehovah would need to involve their heart, including their feelings and motives. One reference work puts it this way: “There is a marked difference between knowing about God and knowing God. It is comparable to the difference between reading about love and falling in love.” We need to know more than the fact that Jehovah has a name and that he is God. We want to come to know the Person behind the name.
paragraph.tl: Ano ang kasama sa pagkilala kay Jehova? May matututuhan tayo sa ipinangako ni Jehova sa mga Judiong babalik mula sa pagkatapon sa Babilonya. Sinabi niya: “Bibigyan ko sila ng isang puso na gusto akong makilala, na ako si Jehova.” ( Jer. 24:7 ) Siguradong marami nang alam tungkol kay Jehova ang mga Judiong iyon. Pero pagbalik nila galing Babilonya, kailangan nilang mas kilalanin pa si Jehova. At sa paggawa niyan, dapat na kasama ang puso nila—kasali diyan ang damdamin at motibo nila. Ganito ang sinabi ng isang reperensiya tungkol diyan: “May malaking pagkakaiba ang makilala mismo ang Diyos at ang basta kilala lamang ang Diyos. Katulad ito ng pagkakaiba ng pagbabasa tungkol sa pag-ibig at ng umibig mismo.” Kaya hindi sapat na basta alam lang natin ang pangalan ni Jehova at na siya ang Diyos. Kailangan nating makilala kung sino talaga siya.

question.tl: Ano ang matututuhan natin kay Haring Josias pagdating sa pagkilala kay Jehova?

paragraph.en: As we come to know Jehovah, we learn what makes him happy and what displeases him. To illustrate, consider the example of King Josiah. The Bible says: “In the 8th year of his reign, while he was still a boy, he started to search for the God of David his forefather.” ( 2 Chron. 34:3 ) But Josiah did more than study. He acted on what he was learning. Through the prophet Jeremiah, Jehovah said that Josiah “upheld justice and righteousness” and that he defended the afflicted and the poor. Then Jehovah added: “Is that not what it means to know me?”​— Jer. 22:15, 16 .
paragraph.tl: Habang nakikilala natin si Jehova, nalalaman natin ang mga gusto at ayaw niya. Tingnan ang halimbawa ni Haring Josias. Sinasabi ng Bibliya: “Nang ika-8 taon ng paghahari niya, noong bata pa siya, sinimulan niyang hanapin ang Diyos ng ninuno niyang si David.” ( 2 Cro. 34:3 ) Pero hindi lang basta kumuha ng kaalaman si Josias tungkol kay Jehova. Kumilos din siya ayon sa mga natutuhan niya. Sa pamamagitan ni propeta Jeremias, sinabi ni Jehova na “itinaguyod [ni Josias] ang katarungan at katuwiran” at na ipinagtanggol nito ang mga dukha at naaapi. Sinabi pa ni Jehova: “Hindi ba ganiyan ang nakakakilala sa akin?”— Jer. 22:​15, 16 .

question.en: As indicated at Psalm 9:10 , how will coming to know Jehovah affect us?
question.tl: Gaya ng ipinapakita sa Awit 9:​10 , ano ang epekto sa atin kapag mas nakilala natin si Jehova?

direct.en: Read Psalm 9:10 . The more we come to know Jehovah, the more we come to trust in him. That principle proved true for the apostle Paul. (Psalm 9:10 ; 2 Tim. 1:12 )
direct.tl: Basahin ang Awit 9:10 . Habang mas nakikilala natin si Jehova, mas lalo tayong nagtitiwala sa kaniya. Naranasan iyan ni apostol Pablo. (Awit 9:10 ; 2 Tim. 1:12 )

paragraph.en: Read Psalm 9:10 . The more we come to know Jehovah, the more we come to trust in him. That principle proved true for the apostle Paul. During his final imprisonment and not long before his death, he wrote: “I am not ashamed. For I know the One whom I have believed.” ( 2 Tim. 1:12 ) What Paul had learned and experienced during his life moved him to trust in his God implicitly. As a study note on that verse explains: “Paul . . . was confident that Jehovah would remember his faithful life course until ‘that day’ when He would resurrect him.”
paragraph.tl: Basahin ang Awit 9:10 . Habang mas nakikilala natin si Jehova, mas lalo tayong nagtitiwala sa kaniya. Naranasan iyan ni apostol Pablo. Noong huling beses siyang mabilanggo at malapit nang mamatay, isinulat niya: “Hindi ako nahihiya. Dahil kilala ko kung sino ang pinaniniwalaan ko.” ( 2 Tim. 1:12 ) Buong-buo ang tiwala ni Pablo kay Jehova. Paano siya nagkaroon ng ganiyang tiwala? Kilalang-kilala kasi niya si Jehova, at naranasan din niya ang pagtulong ni Jehova sa iba’t ibang paraan. Ganito ang paliwanag ng isang study note sa tekstong iyan: “Nagtitiwala [si Pablo na] aalalahanin ni Jehova ang rekord niya ng katapatan hanggang sa ‘araw na iyon’ kung kailan bubuhayin Niya siyang muli.”

question.en: After we have been serving Jehovah for many years, what could happen?
question.tl: Ano ang posibleng mangyari kapag matagal na tayong naglilingkod kay Jehova?

direct.en: Over time, we may not put as much effort into getting to know Jehovah as we did when we first learned about him. Why not? When reading the Bible on our own or along with others at congregation meetings, we may tend to focus on how the information can help us personally in practical ways or how we can use it to help others. (2 Tim. 3:16, 17 ; Ps. 25:8-10 )

paragraph.en: Over time, we may not put as much effort into getting to know Jehovah as we did when we first learned about him. Why not? When reading the Bible on our own or along with others at congregation meetings, we may tend to focus on how the information can help us personally in practical ways or how we can use it to help others. The Scriptures encourage us to do that. ( 2 Tim. 3:16, 17 ) But the Bible also reveals much about its Author. ( Ps. 25:8-10 ) We should never be so absorbed in how the Bible’s message benefits us or others that we fail to ask ourselves, ‘What does this tell me about Jehovah God?’ a
paragraph.tl: Noong una nating makilala si Jehova, talagang nagsikap tayo para matuto nang higit tungkol sa kaniya. Pero paglipas ng panahon, baka hindi na natin masyadong nagagawa iyan. Bakit? Kapag binabasa kasi natin ang Bibliya nang mag-isa o sa mga pulong, baka nakapokus tayo sa kung paano natin iyon magagamit sa buhay natin o sa pagtulong sa iba. Maganda namang gawin iyan, kasi ipinapayo iyan ng Bibliya. ( 2 Tim. 3:​16, 17 ) Pero hindi natin dapat palampasin ang mga puwede nating matutuhan tungkol sa Awtor nito. ( Awit 25:​8-10 ) Kaya kapag nagbabasa ng Bibliya, huwag nating kalimutang pag-isipan, ‘Ano ang itinuturo nito sa akin tungkol kay Jehova?’ a

question.en: What impact will getting to know Jehovah better have on our friendship with him? ( Psalm 73:24-28 )
question.tl: Kapag mas nakilala natin si Jehova, ano ang magiging epekto nito sa kaugnayan natin sa kaniya? ( Awit 73:​24-28 )

direct.en: As we get to know Jehovah better, our friendship with him will grow stronger. For example, how do you feel about Jehovah after you do your daily Bible reading, watch a monthly broadcast, or attend an assembly or a convention? We often feel closer to our heavenly Father. (Psalm 73:24-28 )
direct.tl: Habang mas nakikilala natin si Jehova, mas tumitibay ang pakikipagkaibigan natin sa kaniya. Halimbawa, pagkatapos mong magbasa ng Bibliya, manood ng broadcasting, o dumalo sa isang asamblea o kombensiyon, hindi ba pakiramdam mo na naging mas malapít ka kay Jehova? Mas nakilala mo kasi siya.

deeper.en: This helps me see that Jehovah does not give direction in a distant way; he gives it because he cares about our faith and future. The cited scriptures in the paragraph help me trust that his guidance is loving and that staying close to him is always the safest course.
deeper.tl: Itinuturo nito na si Jehova ay hindi lang nagbibigay ng utos; tinutulungan niya tayong magtiwala sa kaniya sa praktikal na paraan. mas nakikita ko na ang kaniyang patnubay ay para sa ikabubuti natin at para manatili tayong malapít sa kaniya.

paragraph.en: As we get to know Jehovah better, our friendship with him will grow stronger. For example, how do you feel about Jehovah after you do your daily Bible reading, watch a monthly broadcast, or attend an assembly or a convention? We often feel closer to our heavenly Father. Why? Because we have learned more about him. As a result, we are moved to praise and thank him. We feel like the psalmist who meditated on Jehovah’s care for him and who said: “God is the rock of my heart and my portion forever.” (Read Psalm 73:24-28 .) Every effort we make to get to know Jehovah deepens our gratitude for our priceless friendship with him.
paragraph.tl: Habang mas nakikilala natin si Jehova, mas tumitibay ang pakikipagkaibigan natin sa kaniya. Halimbawa, pagkatapos mong magbasa ng Bibliya, manood ng broadcasting, o dumalo sa isang asamblea o kombensiyon, hindi ba pakiramdam mo na naging mas malapít ka kay Jehova? Mas nakilala mo kasi siya. At dahil diyan, gusto mo siyang papurihan at pasalamatan. Nararamdaman din natin ang naramdaman ng salmista nang pag-isipan niya kung paano siya inalagaan ni Jehova. Sinabi niya: “Ang Diyos ang bato ng puso ko at ang bahagi ko magpakailanman.” (Basahin ang Awit 73:​24-28 .) Sa tuwing sinisikap nating mas makilala si Jehova, mas lalo nating napapahalagahan na naging kaibigan natin siya.

question.en: When we “take notice of” Jehovah, how will this affect our decisions? Illustrate.
question.tl: Kung isinasaisip natin si Jehova, ano ang magiging epekto nito sa mga desisyon natin? Magbigay ng ilustrasyon.

direct.en: When we “take notice of” Jehovah​—recalling what we have learned about him and thinking about how our actions affect him—​we will make better decisions. ( Prov. 3:5, 6 ) To illustrate: Many brothers and sisters keep a photograph of their mate on their desk, in their wallet, or on their phone. (Prov. 3:5, 6 ; Ps. 19:13, 14 )
direct.tl: Sinasabi ng Bibliya: “Isaisip mo [si Jehova].” ( Kaw. 3:​5, 6 ) Ibig sabihin niyan, dapat nating pag-isipan ang mga natutuhan natin tungkol sa kaniya at kung ano ang nararamdaman niya sa mga ginagawa natin. Kapag lagi nating isinasaisip si Jehova, makakagawa tayo ng matatalinong desisyon.

deeper.en: This helps me see that Jehovah does not give direction in a distant way; he gives it because he cares about our faith and future. The cited scriptures in the paragraph help me trust that his guidance is loving and that staying close to him is always the safest course.

paragraph.en: When we “take notice of” Jehovah​—recalling what we have learned about him and thinking about how our actions affect him—​we will make better decisions. ( Prov. 3:5, 6 ) To illustrate: Many brothers and sisters keep a photograph of their mate on their desk, in their wallet, or on their phone. This helps them to think fondly and often about their mate, to make decisions that they know will please their mate, and to avoid doing anything that would hurt that person. Similarly, the more often we think about Jehovah, the more likely we will be to make choices that please him.​— Ps. 19:13, 14 .
paragraph.tl: Sinasabi ng Bibliya: “Isaisip mo [si Jehova].” ( Kaw. 3:​5, 6 ) Ibig sabihin niyan, dapat nating pag-isipan ang mga natutuhan natin tungkol sa kaniya at kung ano ang nararamdaman niya sa mga ginagawa natin. Kapag lagi nating isinasaisip si Jehova, makakagawa tayo ng matatalinong desisyon. Para mas maintindihan iyan, pag-isipan ang isang kapatid na may picture ng asawa niya sa mesa niya, wallet, o cellphone. Dahil diyan, lagi niyang naiisip ang asawa niya at kung gaano niya ito kamahal. Kaya nakakagawa siya ng mga desisyong alam niyang magpapasaya sa asawa niya at naiiwasan niya ang mga bagay na makakasakit dito. Kung lagi rin nating isasaisip si Jehova, mas malamang na makagawa tayo ng mga desisyong magpapasaya sa kaniya.​— Awit 19:​13, 14 .

question.en: As we learn about Jehovah, what will we be able to do?
question.tl: Kapag mas nakilala natin si Jehova, ano ang magagawa natin?

direct.en: We are made in Jehovah’s image, which gives us the ability to reflect his qualities. ( Gen. 1:26 ) And the more we learn about Jehovah’s qualities, the better we will understand how to imitate him. (Gen. 1:26 ; Matt. 23:23 ; 1 John 4:8, 11 )
direct.tl: Nilalang tayo ayon sa larawan ni Jehova, kaya may kakayahan tayong ipakita ang mga katangian niya. ( Gen. 1:26 ) At kapag mas natutuhan natin ang mga katangian ni Jehova, mas matutularan natin siya. (Gen. 1:26 )

paragraph.en: We are made in Jehovah’s image, which gives us the ability to reflect his qualities. ( Gen. 1:26 ) And the more we learn about Jehovah’s qualities, the better we will understand how to imitate him. Jesus condemned the scribes and Pharisees for their failure to show godly qualities. Although they paid close attention to the minor details of the Law, they “disregarded the weightier matters of the Law, namely, justice and mercy and faithfulness.” ( Matt. 23:23 ) Unlike those religious leaders, let us do our best to understand how Jehovah’s qualities are reflected in his laws and principles. Doing so will help us to demonstrate those very qualities.​— 1 John 4:8, 11 .
paragraph.tl: Nilalang tayo ayon sa larawan ni Jehova, kaya may kakayahan tayong ipakita ang mga katangian niya. ( Gen. 1:26 ) At kapag mas natutuhan natin ang mga katangian ni Jehova, mas matutularan natin siya. Hindi iyan nagawa ng mga eskriba at Pariseo. Alam na alam nila ang maliliit na detalye ng Kautusan, pero sinabi ni Jesus na binale-wala naman nila “ang mas mahahalagang bagay sa Kautusan: ang katarungan at awa at katapatan.” ( Mat. 23:23 ) Ayaw nating maging gaya nila. Gusto nating hanapin ang mga katangian ni Jehova na makikita sa mga utos at prinsipyo sa Bibliya. Kapag ginawa natin iyan, matutularan natin ang mga katangian niya.​— 1 Juan 4:​8, 11 .

paragraph.en: Who introduced you to Jehovah? Perhaps you were raised by Christian parents. They likely related Bible accounts that reveal God’s qualities and taught you how the things he created reflect his personality. Or you may have accepted a Bible study from one of Jehovah’s Witnesses. Using a study aid, such as the Enjoy Life Forever! book, your Bible teacher helped you to analyze Scriptural accounts and to learn about Jehovah’s appealing qualities by studying the natural world. b ( Neh. 8:8; Acts 14:17 ) Let us consider how we can continue learning about Jehovah.

Baka Saksi ang mga magulang mo, at itinuro nila sa iyo ang mga katangian ni Jehova gamit ang mga ulat sa Bibliya at ang mga nilalang niya. O baka una mong nakilala si Jehova nang magpa-Bible study ka sa isang Saksi ni Jehova. At gamit ang isang pantulong sa pag-aaral, gaya ng aklat na Masayang Buhay Magpakailanman, tinulungan ka niyang pag-isipan ang mga ulat sa Bibliya at ang mga nilalang para malaman ang magagandang katangian ni Jehova. b ( Neh. 8:8; Gawa 14:17 ) Tingnan natin ngayon kung ano ang puwede nating gawin para patuloy tayong matuto tungkol kay Jehova.

paragraph.en:
First, we can learn more about Jehovah by reading and studying his Word. Sometimes, the Bible specifically identifies God’s qualities. ( Ex. 34:6, 7 ) More often, though, it relates events involving humans and the decisions they made. When you read such accounts, think about what they can teach you about Jehovah.

Consider an example. While reading Jeremiah 38:6-13 , you learn about the Ethiopian Ebed-melech, who rescued the prophet Jeremiah. Doubtless, you quickly identify ways that you can imitate Ebed-melech’s self-sacrifice, courage, and love for his fellow worshippers. Do you also see what qualities of Jehovah are revealed in this account? (Read Jeremiah 39:15-18 .) For instance, what verse indicates that Jehovah is appreciative? Fair? Impartial? What other aspects of Jehovah’s personality do you discern in this account? Whenever you read a passage in God’s Word, identify Jehovah’s qualities that are reflected, and then thank and praise him for those qualities.
paragraph.tl:
Una, puwede pa tayong matuto tungkol kay Jehova kapag nagbabasa tayo at nag-aaral ng Salita niya. Kung minsan, direktang sinasabi sa Bibliya ang mga katangian ni Jehova. ( Ex. 34:​6, 7 ) Pero mas madalas, mababasa dito ang mga ulat tungkol sa mga tao at sa mga desisyong ginawa nila. Kapag nagbabasa ka ng ganitong ulat, pag-isipan kung ano ang matututuhan mo dito tungkol kay Jehova.

Tingnan ang isang halimbawa. Kapag binasa mo ang Jeremias 38:​6-13 , makikita mo ang ulat tungkol sa Etiope na si Ebed-melec, na nagligtas sa propetang si Jeremias. Siguradong maiisip mo agad kung paano mo matutularan ang mga katangian ni Ebed-melec, gaya ng pagiging mapagsakripisyo, pagkakaroon ng lakas ng loob, at pagmamalasakit sa mga kapananampalataya. Pero naiisip mo rin ba kung anong mga katangian ni Jehova ang makikita sa ulat na ito? (Basahin ang Jeremias 39:​15-18 .) Halimbawa, anong talata ang nagpapakita na mapagpahalaga si Jehova? Na makatarungan siya? Na hindi siya nagtatangi? May naiisip ka pa bang ibang katangian ni Jehova na makikita sa ulat na ito? Sa tuwing nagbabasa ka ng Bibliya, hanapin ang mga katangian ni Jehova. Pagkatapos, pasalamatan mo siya at sabihin sa kaniya kung gaano mo siya kamahal dahil sa mga katangian niyang iyon.

question.en: What can we do to benefit fully from what we observe in creation?
question.tl: Bakit dapat nating pag-isipang mabuti ang mga nilalang ni Jehova?

paragraph.en: Second, we can learn more about Jehovah by meditating on his creative works. ( Ps. 145:9, 10 ) Of course, simply observing the natural world is not enough. Some spend their entire lives studying nature but fail to acknowledge God’s qualities or even his existence! The apostle Paul wrote that God’s “invisible qualities are clearly seen from the world’s creation onward, because they are perceived by the things made.” ( Rom. 1:20 ) One translation of this verse says that we can perceive God’s qualities because they are “visible . . . to the eye of reason.” So we must think about and reason on what we see in order to discern the qualities of our Creator.
paragraph.tl: Ikalawa, puwede rin tayong matuto nang higit tungkol kay Jehova kapag binulay-bulay natin ang mga nilalang niya. ( Awit 145:​9, 10 ) Hindi sapat na obserbahan lang natin ang mga ito. May ilang tao na buong buhay nang pinag-aralan ang mga nilalang, pero hindi pa rin sila naniwala na may Diyos na lumalang sa mga ito at hindi rin nila nakita ang magaganda niyang katangian. Isinulat ni apostol Pablo na ang “di-nakikitang mga katangian [ng Diyos] ay malinaw na nakikita mula pa nang lalangin ang mundo, dahil ang mga ito . . . ay nakikita sa mga bagay na ginawa niya.” ( Roma 1:20 ) Ayon sa isang salin ng tekstong ito, ang mga katangian ng Diyos ay “nakikita ng mata ng pang-unawa.” Kaya kapag inoobserbahan natin ang mga nilalang, dapat tayong gumamit ng kaunawaan para malinaw nating makita ang mga katangian ni Jehova.

paragraph.en: Many of us live in urban areas that seem distant from the natural world. If this is your situation, can you still learn lessons from creation? Consider Patrick, who lives in Brazzaville, a large city in the Republic of the Congo. He relates: “I strive to observe creation from my balcony. I often see tiny insects or small birds busily looking for food or for a place to live. Once, I observed some birds making their nest. They found and used materials in our neighborhood that were perfectly suited for welcoming small chicks.” But Patrick did not stop there; he thought deeply about the Creator. He says: “I learned that Jehovah cares about the well-being of his creatures, even those that seem insignificant. This assures me that he also cares about me and will not fail to provide me with what I need.”
paragraph.tl: Marami sa atin ang nakatira sa mga siyudad kung saan walang masyadong halaman at mga hayop. Kahit ganiyan ang sitwasyon mo, may magagawa ka pa rin para matuto sa mga nilalang. Tingnan ang halimbawa ni Patrick. Nakatira siya sa Brazzaville, isang malaking siyudad sa Republic of the Congo. Ikinuwento niya: “Pumupunta ako sa balkonahe ko para pagmasdan ang mga nilalang ni Jehova. Madalas akong makakita ng maliliit na insekto o ibon na naghahanap ng pagkain o ng bahay. Minsan, nakakita ako ng mga ibon na gumagawa ng pugad. Nakagawa sila ng magandang pugad gamit lang ang mga bagay-bagay na nakuha nila sa paligid, at saktong-sakto iyon para sa mga anak nila.” Pero hindi lang basta inobserbahan ni Patrick ang mga ibon—pinag-isipan din niya ang lumalang sa mga ito. Sinabi niya: “Nakita ko na hindi pinapabayaan ni Jehova ang mga nilalang niya, kahit y’ong mga hindi gaanong napapansin. Kaya sigurado akong mahal din ako ni Jehova at ibibigay niya ang mga kailangan ko.”

paragraph.en: A third way we can get to know Jehovah better is by meditating on our own experiences. That is what Jesus’ mother, Mary, did. She already knew Jehovah well, and she had “found favor with [him].” ( Luke 1:30 ) But then she was given a weighty assignment​—to be the mother of God’s Son. Through the angel Gabriel and Mary’s relative Elizabeth, Jehovah strengthened Mary and reassured her. She later meditated on what her experience had revealed about Jehovah​—including his power, mercy, impartiality, and interest in even the lowly ones. ( Luke 1:46-55 ) Just as Mary was appreciative of God’s support, we are grateful when Jehovah gives us help “at the right time.” ( Heb. 4:16 ) When you receive this help, ask yourself: ‘What has this taught me about Jehovah? Which qualities of Jehovah has this experience revealed?’
paragraph.tl: Ikatlo, puwede rin nating mas makilala si Jehova kung pag-iisipan natin ang mga ginawa niya para sa atin. Iyan ang ginawa ng ina ni Jesus na si Maria. Kilalang-kilala na niya si Jehova, at “nalulugod sa [kaniya] ang Diyos.” ( Luc. 1:30 ) Pagkatapos, binigyan siya ni Jehova ng atas—ang maging ina ng Anak ng Diyos. Mabigat na atas iyon, pero pinatibay siya ni Jehova sa pamamagitan ng kamag-anak niyang si Elisabet at ng anghel na si Gabriel. Pagkatapos nito, pinag-isipan ni Maria kung paano siya tinulungan ni Jehova at ang mga katangian ni Jehova na natutuhan niya mula dito. Naging mas malinaw sa kaniya na makapangyarihan si Jehova, maawain, di-nagtatangi, at nagmamalasakit kahit sa mga itinuturing ng iba na mabababa. ( Luc. 1:​46-55 ) Gaya ni Maria, nagpapasalamat din tayo na tinutulungan tayo ni Jehova “sa tamang panahon.” ( Heb. 4:16 ) Kaya kapag naranasan mo ang tulong ni Jehova, pag-isipan ang mga ito: ‘Ano ang itinuturo nito sa akin tungkol kay Jehova? Anong mga katangian ni Jehova ang nakita ko dito?’

question.en: Why can we say that we will never stop learning about Jehovah?
question.tl: Bakit natin nasabi na hindi tayo mauubusan ng matututuhan tungkol kay Jehova?

paragraph.en:
Think of how much more we will learn about Jehovah in the new world. We will receive new scrolls that reveal his requirements for us. ( Rev. 20:12 ) We will be able to interact more closely with the natural world. ( Isa. 11:6-9 ) And we will deepen our understanding of our Father as we experience new things, including our loved ones being resurrected and our getting closer to perfection every day.

We will never stop getting to know Jehovah. He has already lived for an eternity, so “his understanding is beyond measure.” ( Ps. 90:2; 147:5 ) We “will never find out the work that the true God has made from start to finish.” ( Eccl. 3:11 ) Therefore, regardless of how long we have been in the truth, may we seize every opportunity to learn more about our loving Father.
paragraph.tl:
Isip-isipin kung gaano pa karami ang matututuhan natin tungkol kay Jehova sa bagong sanlibutan. Bibigyan tayo ni Jehova ng bagong mga balumbon para malaman natin ang mga gusto niyang gawin natin sa Paraiso. ( Apoc. 20:12 ) Mas mae-enjoy rin natin ang mga nilalang ni Jehova. ( Isa. 11:​6-9 ) At mas marami pa tayong malalaman tungkol kay Jehova kapag naranasan na natin ang mga bagay na hindi pa natin naranasan noon, gaya ng pagkabuhay-muli ng mga mahal natin sa buhay at unti-unti nating pagiging perpekto.

Hindi tayo mauubusan ng matututuhan tungkol kay Jehova. Umiiral na siya mula pa sa panahong walang pasimula, kaya “hindi masusukat ang lawak ng kaniyang kaunawaan.” ( Awit 90:2; 147:5 ) At ‘hinding-hindi natin mauunawaan ang lahat ng gawa ng tunay na Diyos mula pasimula hanggang wakas.’ ( Ecles. 3:11 ) Kaya gaano man tayo katagal nang naglilingkod kay Jehova, samantalahin sana natin ang bawat pagkakataon na matuto nang higit tungkol sa ating mapagmahal na Ama.
